statement: ∀ (N : ℕ), 0 < N → ∀ t ∈ GPI, ∃ i : ℕ, i < N ∧ t ∈ Set.Icc ((i : ℝ) / N) (((i : ℝ) + 1) / N)
proof:
intro N hN t ht
have hNr : (0 : ℝ) < N := Nat.cast_pos.mpr hN
rcases ht with ⟨ht0, ht1⟩
by_cases he : t = 1
· subst t
  refine ⟨N - 1, by omega, ?_, ?_⟩
  · apply (div_le_iff₀ hNr).2
    have : ((N - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) ≤ (N : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast Nat.sub_le N 1
    simpa using this
  · apply (le_div_iff₀ hNr).2
    have : ((N - 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) + 1 = (N : ℝ) := by
      norm_cast
      omega
    linarith
· have htlt : t < 1 := lt_of_le_of_ne ht1 he
  refine ⟨⌊t * N⌋₊, (Nat.floor_lt (mul_nonneg ht0 hNr.le)).2 ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · nlinarith
  · exact (div_le_iff₀ hNr).2 (Nat.floor_le (mul_nonneg ht0 hNr.le))
  · exact (le_div_iff₀ hNr).2 (Nat.lt_floor_add_one (t * N)).le

      (∀ (k : ℕ) (z : GPEucl (k + 1)), GPappend (GPhead z) (z.ofLp (Fin.last k)) = z) ∧
        (∀ (k : ℕ) (x y : GPEucl k) (t u : ℝ), dist (GPappend x t) (GPappend y u) = √(dist x y ^ 2 + |t - u| ^ 2)) ∧
          ∀ (k : ℕ) (z w : GPEucl (k + 1)),
            dist (GPhead z) (GPhead w) ≤ dist z w ∧ |z.ofLp (Fin.last k) - w.ofLp (Fin.last k)| ≤ dist z w) →
    (∀ (k : ℕ) (A : Set (GPEucl k)) (s : ℝ),
        0 < s →
          GPmass s A = (MeasureTheory.Measure.hausdorffMeasure s) A ∧
            0 ≤ dimH A ∧
              (dimH A < ENNReal.ofReal s → GPmass s A = 0) ∧
                (ENNReal.ofReal s < dimH A → GPmass s A = ⊤) ∧
                  (GPmass s A = 0 → dimH A ≤ ENNReal.ofReal s) ∧
                    (GPmass s A = ⊤ → ENNReal.ofReal s ≤ dimH A) ∧
                      (∀ (δ₁ δ₂ : ℝ), 0 < δ₁ → 0 < δ₂ → δ₁ ≤ δ₂ → GPcontent s δ₂ A ≤ GPcontent s δ₁ A) ∧
                        (GPmass s A = 0 →
                            ∀ (δ ε : ℝ), 0 < δ → 0 < ε → ∃ U, GPcover A δ U ∧ GPcost s U < ENNReal.ofReal ε) ∧
                          (GPmass s A = ⊤ →
                            ∀ (L δ₀ : ℝ), 0 < L → 0 < δ₀ → ∃ δ, 0 < δ ∧ δ ≤ δ₀ ∧ ENNReal.ofReal L < GPcontent s δ A)) →
      Bornology.IsBounded E ∧
          (∃ R, 0 < R ∧ ∀ x ∈ E, ∀ (j : Fin n), -R ≤ x.ofLp j ∧ x.ofLp j ≤ R) ∧
            (∀ (s δ : ℝ),
                0 < s →
